Background / Context

The project involves developing a content management system (CMS) tailored for Ruby on Rails developers. Refinery CMS is designed to create customizable and content-manageable websites efficiently by adhering to "The Rails Way." It is well-suited for developers familiar with Ruby on Rails and aims to streamline the development process.

Objectives

- Provide an intuitive CMS for building and managing websites.
- Simplify content creation and management with visual tools.
- Support easy customization through extensions and plugins.
- Facilitate secure user authentication and role management.
- Enable seamless integration of media files and resources.

Stakeholders & Users

- Developers: Primarily Ruby on Rails developers who will implement and customize websites using Refinery CMS.
- Administrators: Users responsible for managing website content, structure, and user access.
- End-users: Individuals who will interact with the front-end of websites built on Refinery CMS.

Functional Descriptions

1. Page Management: 
   - Edit and organize pages using a visual editor.
   - Manage site structure and navigation.

2. Media Management:
   - Upload and insert images seamlessly using Dragonfly.
   - Store media on Amazon S3 for scalability.
   - Manage and link to various resources such as PDF documents.

3. User Authentication & Roles:
   - Manage user access and roles using Devise.
   - Define permissions for extensions and functionalities per user.

4. Extension Support:
   - Generate custom extensions using the Refinery extension generator.
   - Popular extensions include:
     - Blog: Manage posts, categories, and comments.
     - Portfolio: Create image galleries.
     - News: Post and manage news items.
     - Inquiries: Handle contact form submissions and notifications.

Non-Functional Descriptions

- Ease of Use: Designed to be approachable for Ruby on Rails developers, leveraging Rails conventions.
- Scalability: Supports scalable media storage with Amazon S3 integration.
- Security: Secure authentication and role management using industry-standard practices (Devise).
- Extensibility: Easily extensible through generators and available plugins.

-- Schema for database: schemabench_0006
CREATE TABLE `roles` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_roles_on_name` (`name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `encrypted_password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `reset_password_token` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reset_password_sent_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `remember_created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `sign_in_count` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `current_sign_in_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_sign_in_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `current_sign_in_ip` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_sign_in_ip` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_users_on_email` (`email`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_users_on_reset_password_token` (`reset_password_token`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `user_roles` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `role_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `index_user_roles_on_user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `index_user_roles_on_role_id` (`role_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `user_roles_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `user_roles_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`role_id`) REFERENCES `roles` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `pages` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `parent_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `menu_title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `body` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `position` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `show_in_menu` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_pages_on_slug` (`slug`),
  KEY `index_pages_on_parent_id` (`parent_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `pages_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_id`) REFERENCES `pages` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `resources` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `file_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `content_type` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `file_size` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `s3_key` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `s3_bucket` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `images` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `resource_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `alt_text` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `caption` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_images_on_resource_id` (`resource_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `images_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`resource_id`) REFERENCES `resources` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `blog_categories` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_blog_categories_on_slug` (`slug`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `blog_posts` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `category_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `body` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `published_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `author_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_blog_posts_on_slug` (`slug`),
  KEY `index_blog_posts_on_category_id` (`category_id`),
  KEY `index_blog_posts_on_author_id` (`author_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `blog_posts_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `blog_categories` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `blog_posts_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`author_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `blog_comments` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `post_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `body` text NOT NULL,
  `approved` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `index_blog_comments_on_post_id` (`post_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `blog_comments_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`post_id`) REFERENCES `blog_posts` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `portfolio_galleries` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_portfolio_galleries_on_slug` (`slug`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `portfolio_images` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `gallery_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `resource_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `position` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `caption` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `index_portfolio_images_on_gallery_id` (`gallery_id`),
  KEY `index_portfolio_images_on_resource_id` (`resource_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `portfolio_images_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`gallery_id`) REFERENCES `portfolio_galleries` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `portfolio_images_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`resource_id`) REFERENCES `resources` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `news_items` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `body` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `published_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_news_items_on_slug` (`slug`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `inquiries` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `message` text NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
